In [49]:
def analyze_comment_sentiment(comment):
    compound = sia.polarity_scores(comment)['compound']

    if compound > 0.05:
        label = "Positive"
        insight = " The comment express positive emotion or approval"
    elif compound < 0.05:
        label = "Negative"
        insight = " The comment express dissatifaction or negative emotion"
    else :
        label= "Neutal"
        insight = " The comment is informational or emotionally neutal"

    return {
        "label" : label,
        "score" : compound,
        "insight" : insight
    }
